assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, dizziness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of underlying sick sinus syndrome and paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
A 30-day continuous ambulatory ECG monitoring study (CPT 93247) is required to correlate clinical events with rhythm disturbances, evaluate for arrhythmia burden, and guide further management.
The service was billed against diagnosis codes I49.5, I48.91, and I49.9.
The diagnosis codes support the medical necessity of this long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring study.
